content_of_post_to_answer: Can we create stuff with our minds once we die?
answer: The interesting question is not only whether we create after death, but what kind of “creation” a mind could produce without a physical world to interact with. Our imagination is shaped by memories, sensations, and limits, so a post-death reality created by consciousness might reveal how deeply our experiences define us. I've explored similar ideas about consciousness and perception in more detail on my profile, for anyone curious. The mind may not create from nothing; it may transform everything it has ever absorbed.
